title: Police Blotter: 17 booked in Webb County — end-of-day roundup
excerpt: Seventeen people were booked into the Webb County Jail on November 17, 2026, on alleged misdemeanor charges and holds — DWI, assault, burglary of a vehicle, criminal mischief and more. Every arrest is an allegation; each person is presumed innocent until proven guilty.
content:
Seventeen people were booked into the Webb County Jail on Tuesday, November 17, 2026, on alleged misdemeanor charges and holds, according to Webb County booking records. Each person is listed below with the charge shown in their booking record. An arrest is an allegation, not a conviction, and every person named here is presumed innocent until proven guilty in a court of law.

Josue Ivan Alvarado

Josue Ivan Alvarado was arrested on Tuesday, November 17, 2026, at 12:15 a.m. on an alleged charge of assault causing bodily injury — family member, a Class A misdemeanor. Bond was set at $10,000. He was magistrated on Tuesday, November 17, 2026, at 2:53 p.m. The booking record also shows an out-of-county/state hold.
